dataset_rule: Clinic-first mixed-source public-pricing seed. procedures[] contains every numeric-priced service captured from the reviewed public source for that clinic. Flagship categories are indexes only, not a filter.

trust_policy.official_public_price_page: Direct clinic/practice public pricing page; preferred.
trust_policy.official_context_price: Clinic's own public educational/planning range; use below direct posted price.
trust_policy.public_pricing_directory: Third-party public pricing directory; lower trust than clinic-site pricing.
trust_policy.market_benchmark: City/metro benchmark only; never present it as a clinic quote.

limitations: This is a best-effort public-web seed, not a guaranteed exhaustive site-wide audit of every clinic.
Booking-only, login-only, private-quote, phone-only and unindexed prices may be absent.
Rows without numeric public pricing are omitted rather than estimated.
Directory-derived rows are explicitly marked and should rank below official clinic-site pricing in Explore.
Market benchmarks are stored separately and are not counted as clinic coverage.
